title: Stripline: a 1.5 mm strip of no thickness across the middle of a PTFE-filled 6 × 3 mm box, 6 mm long: TEM through ports solved with the strip in their cross-section
source: Two conductors in one homogeneous dielectric carry a TEM wave with β = k0 √εr whatever the cross-section (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.7), so S21 = exp(−jβL) and S11 = 0

quantities.reason: 1.5 mm cells graded to a twentieth at the strip's edges (E ∝ r^{−1/2} there), order 2: −0.003°
1.5e-4: the edges' singularity resolved by the grading
